findings.quote: most patients describe soreness afterward rather than sharp pain
findings.why: This is a harmless general statement about post-implant discomfort, but it has no source behind it.
findings.fix: Cite an ADA or NIDCR page, or soften it to something like 'Some soreness afterward is common; your dentist will explain what to expect.'

findings.why: The ficha lists Dr. Oyelaran's focus as family and pediatric dentistry and clear aligners, not implants, so he is an odd medical reviewer for an implant post.
findings.fix: Consider having Dr. Elena Marsh, who lists implants as a focus, be named as the clinical reviewer, or add a note on who reviewed which part.
